en: A vintage sepia-toned aerial view of a small European town nestled among hills and fields. Dense rows of houses with pitched roofs fill the foreground, with a prominent ornate building featuring a tall clock tower rising near the center-right. Industrial buildings with chimneys stand to the left and in the background, and forested hills and farmland stretch into the distance. The word "Waldheim." is printed in red at the top left, and there is small vertical red printing along the right edge.
